global.garment_shape_lock: GARMENT SHAPE & LENGTH — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The garment's silhouette, length, and construction must match the product reference exactly. Apply the rule for whichever garment type is shown: tops and t-shirts must NOT be shortened into a crop top or cropped tee; shirts and blouses must retain collar, cuffs, and hemline unchanged; jackets and blazers must retain lapels, length, and structure — do NOT shorten or lengthen; dresses and skirts must keep the hemline at the exact same point — a midi stays midi, ankle-length stays ankle-length; outerwear (coats, hoodies) must retain length, hood shape, and structure; caps and hats must retain brim shape, crown height, and style exactly; footwear must retain silhouette, sole height, and style — sneakers stay sneakers, heels stay heels, sandals stay sandals. The pose reference person may wear a different garment — take ONLY their body stance, never their garment shape, length, or silhouette.
global.print_lock_angle: PRINT/PATTERN — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The product reference images may show multiple views (front, back, etc.). Each print or graphic is FIXED to a specific side — do NOT transfer a print from the back onto the front or vice versa. Reproduce ONLY the print naturally visible from this angle of the garment. Do NOT rescale, simplify, alter, or replace the print.
global.footwear_block: Do NOT copy or reproduce footwear from any reference image — ignore the shoes on the model in reference image 1 and ignore any footwear visible in the product reference images. Default to simple nude pointed-toe heels unless a different footwear is specified in the global instruction. Apply the same footwear consistently across every shot in this set.

garment_orientation.Front: GARMENT ORIENTATION — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The FRONT of the garment must face the camera. Model faces forward directly toward the camera. Do NOT show the back of the garment.
garment_orientation.Styled: GARMENT ORIENTATION: By default the FRONT of the garment must be visible. EXCEPTION: Only show the BACK of the garment if the shot instruction or global instruction explicitly requests a back-styled shot.
garment_orientation.Side: GARMENT ORIENTATION — NON-NEGOTIABLE: Show the garment at a three-quarter angle — body turned mostly to the right but rotated slightly toward the camera so that a portion of the front of the garment is also visible. garment_orientation.Back: GARMENT ORIENTATION — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The BACK of the garment must face the camera. Model faces completely away from the camera.

e_shared.bgLock: BACKGROUND COLOR — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The wall color and floor color from the background reference image must appear EXACTLY as shown — same hue, same saturation, same brightness. f_fabric_swap.intro: FABRIC SWAP TASK: Replace the fabric, print, and pattern of the garment with the new swatch shown in the fabric reference image. Preserve the exact garment construction — neckline, silhouette, seams, hemline, sleeves, collar, cuffs, and all structural details remain UNCHANGED. Only the surface fabric changes.
f_fabric_swap.swatch_fidelity: FABRIC FIDELITY — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The new fabric must match the swatch reference image EXACTLY — same color values, same pattern motifs, same scale, same density, same repeat. Do NOT alter, simplify, reinterpret, or recolor any element of the swatch pattern. The colors in the swatch must appear on the garment at the exact same hue, saturation, and brightness — do NOT shift, warm, cool, or adjust the swatch colors to match the scene or ambient lighting. FABRIC REALISM — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The print must integrate into the actual fabric surface — it must conform to the garment's 3D form, following drape lines, fold creases, seam curves, and body contours naturally. Shadows in folds and highlights on raised fabric areas must modulate the print exactly as real printed textile behaves. The result must look like genuine fabric PRINTED or WOVEN with this pattern — NOT a digital overlay or flat composite placed on top. Fabric texture and natural light/shadow must remain perceptible through the pattern.
f_fabric_swap.target_full_outfit: FABRIC TARGET: Replace the fabric on the ENTIRE outfit — top, bottom, and all garment pieces visible in this shot.
f_fabric_swap.target_topwear: FABRIC TARGET: Replace the fabric on the TOP GARMENT ONLY — shirt, blouse, top, or jacket. Do NOT alter the fabric of any bottom garment, skirt, trousers, or footwear.
f_fabric_swap.target_bottomwear: FABRIC TARGET: Replace the fabric on the BOTTOM GARMENT ONLY — trousers, skirt, or shorts. Do NOT alter the fabric of any top garment.
f_fabric_swap.target_innerwear: FABRIC TARGET: Replace the fabric on the INNERWEAR ONLY. Do NOT alter any outerwear or other garment layer.
f_fabric_swap.target_outerwear: FABRIC TARGET: Replace the fabric on the OUTERWEAR ONLY — jacket, coat, or hoodie. Do NOT alter any inner garment layer.
f_fabric_swap.target_footwear: FABRIC TARGET: Replace the fabric or material on the FOOTWEAR ONLY. Do NOT alter any clothing garments.
f_fabric_swap.construction_lock: CONSTRUCTION — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The garment's physical construction must be IDENTICAL to the product reference image — same silhouette, same cut, same seam lines, same hemline, same neckline, same collar, same sleeve style, same cuffs, same buttons, same pockets, same waist details. The only change is the surface fabric. Do NOT alter any structural element of the garment.
